upgrade_level.name: Upgrade level
upgrade_level.description: Raise this building one level: it gains its base HP. Price starts at {{baseCost}} and rises by {{costStep}} each level (max level {{maxLevel}}).

selling.name: Selling
selling.description: Permanently unlock selling packs (up to {{maxPerRound}} per deployment phase). Refund is {{refundPct}}% of base cost.

attack_boost.name: Attack Boost
attack_boost.description: Permanent army-wide damage boost. First tier +{{attackPct}}%; buy tiers in order (costs {{costs}}).

hp_boost.name: HP Boost
hp_boost.description: Permanent army-wide HP boost. First tier +{{hpPct}}%; buy tiers in order (costs {{costs}}).

range_boost.name: Range Boost
range_boost.description: +{{amount}} range for all ranged units, this round only.

speed_boost.name: Speed Boost
speed_boost.description: +{{amount}} speed for all units, this round only.

loan.name: Loan
loan.description: +{{gain}} supply now. Next deployment: −{{debt}}. Once per round.

ward_dome.name: Ward dome
ward_dome.description: Absorbs enemy projectiles that cross into a dome (radius {{radius}}, height {{height}}). Absorption capacity equals this unit’s HP.

homing_fire_bolt.name: Homing Fire Bolt
homing_fire_bolt.description: Primes in place, then homes onto the first enemy in range {{range}} for {{damage}} damage (splash {{splash}}).

rally_route.name: Rally Route
rally_route.description: Add one rally-route charge to your spells strip. Once per match.

move_pack.name: Move Pack
move_pack.description: Add one move-pack charge to your spells strip: one pack from an earlier round becomes movable again. Once per match.

1_deployment.name: +1 Deployment
1_deployment.description: One extra unit purchase this round only.

veteran_training.name: Veteran Training
veteran_training.description: For the rest of this round, units you buy arrive at level 2 (they still pay the level premium).

send_supply_to_ally.name: Send supply to ally
send_supply_to_ally.description: Gift 100 supply to your ally — arrives at the start of next round. Duo modes only.
